title: Counter overhead bound for an initial segment
statement: For every Boolean word $w$ and natural number $r$ with $r\le V(w)$, where $V(w)$ is the binary value of $w$, the counter overhead accumulated over the first $r$ rounds is at most $4r+2|w|$.
hypotheses_covered: The round count satisfies $r\le V(w)$, where $V(w)$ is the binary value of $w$
